title: Trajectory-Regularized Stochastic Optimal Control via KL Divergence
abstract: arXiv:2607.22201v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce trajectory-regularized stochastic optimal control (TRSOC), which augments standard stochastic optimal control (SOC) with a Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between controlled and reference trajectory distributions. Using Girsanov's theorem, the trajectory KL reduces to a quadratic drift mismatch penalty, yielding a modified running cost that preserves the dynamic programming (DP) structure. We derive the corresponding Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equation and characterize the optimal policy. In the linear-quadratic (LQ) setting, the formulation admits a closed-form solution with an augmented control cost. Experiments show that the regularization parameter induces a trade-off between performance-driven and reference-preserving behavior, including cases with reference dynamics learned from offline data.

translated_title: 基于KL散度的轨迹正则化随机最优控制
translated_abstract: 我们提出了轨迹正则化随机最优控制（TRSOC），它在标准随机最优控制（SOC）的基础上增加了受控轨迹分布与参考轨迹分布之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度。利用Girsanov定理，轨迹KL散度可简化为二次漂移失配惩罚，从而得到一种保持动态规划（DP）结构的修正运行成本。我们推导了相应的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程并刻画了最优策略。在线性二次（LQ）设置下，该公式具有带增广控制成本的闭式解。实验表明，正则化参数在性能驱动行为与参考保持行为之间引入了权衡，其中包括参考动力学从离线数据中学习的情形。
tldr: 该论文提出轨迹正则化随机最优控制（TRSOC），通过在标准随机最优控制中加入受控与参考轨迹分布间的KL散度正则项，并借助Girsanov定理将其化为二次漂移失配惩罚，在保持动态规划结构的同时推导出HJB方程与最优策略，并在LQ情形下获得闭式解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes trajectory-regularized stochastic optimal control (TRSOC), which augments standard SOC with a KL divergence between controlled and reference trajectory distributions; via Girsanov's theorem this reduces to a quadratic drift mismatch penalty that preserves the dynamic programming structure, yielding the HJB equation, an optimal policy characterization, and a closed-form LQ solution.
